title: Passing Yards V237 Direct V187 Shell
root_cause: After V237 positively identifies NFL -> Passing Yards and installs V85 ownership, it still re-enters V236 -> V235 -> the full historical router chain. Hosted production commits NFL and Passing Yards but remains in a long rerun before V85 emits its first marker.
patch: For Passing Yards only, V237 installs V85 ownership and calls V187's already-certified _render_direct_prop root-shell dispatcher directly. Non-Passing-Yards routes continue through V236 unchanged.
acceptance: Non-Passing-Yards route still delegates exactly once through V236.
Passing Yards installs V85 owner and enters V187 direct shell without calling V236 historical re-entry.
Two synthetic Passing Yards sessions can enter direct shell concurrently.
Branch UI NFL -> Passing Yards emits V85 and does not show V187 RuntimeError.
DevSystem final gate passes before merge.
